Armor 28 Ultra

4.9

Global 5G Connectivity: High-efficiency 5G technology with dual SIM support delivers an intelligent, high-speed network foundation for seamless professional communication and data management.

Dimensity 9300+ AI: The 4nm MediaTek Dimensity 9300+ processor utilizes a hardware-based generative AI engine and 12-core GPU to provide unrivaled computational speed and hardware-accelerated ray tracing.

Massive Memory Architecture: Equipped with 32GB RAM(16GB RAM + 16GB Virtual RAM), 1024GB ROM, and 2TB expansion on Android 15, this system ensures high-efficiency multitasking and eliminates storage bottlenecks for data-heavy workflows.

Professional Imaging System: The 1-inch Sony IMX989 sensor enables 8K video recording, complemented by a 50MP ultra-wide lens and a 64MP NightElf Ultra 3.0 night vision camera for ultimate clarity in any lighting.

Dual AMOLED Displays: A 6.67" 120Hz AMOLED main screen reaching 2200 nits peak brightness is paired with a 1.04" rear sub-display for instant notifications and high-efficiency touch control.

High-Capacity Power System: The 120W fast charging and 50W wireless charging capabilities provide rapid recovery for the high-capacity battery, ensuring up to 576 hours of standby for remote field operations.

Military-Grade Durability: Engineered with Corning Gorilla Glass 5 and certified to MIL-STD-810H, IP68, and IP69K standards, this device provides unrivaled protection against water, dust, and high-impact drops.

AI Toolbox Integration: The integrated AI Toolbox and 10Gbps USB 3.2 Gen 2 interface enable advanced digital human generation, AI photography, and high-speed data transfers for professional field analysis.

Advanced Utility Suite: uSmart Expansion Connector, Widevine L1, Wifi 7, IR Blaster, Fingerprint Unlock, NFC, Headset-Free FM Radio, Custom Key, Outdoor Toolbox, 3-Card Slot, GPS + GLONASS + Beidou + Galileo, Gloves Mode, etc.

Discount Code FAQ

1. How do I use the discount code?

Copy the discount code from the product page, and then apply the discount code at check out.

2. Can I redeem multiple discount codes?

No. Discount codes cannot be combined. Only one code can be applied per order.

3. Why is my discount code invalid?

  1. The discount code is not applicable to the specific items you want to buy
  2. The discount code wasn't entered correctly
  3. The discount code has expired
  4. The discount code is not from Ulefone's official website

Notes:

1. The battery is non-removable, removing it may cause damage to the device.

2. Product size and weight may vary by configuration, manufacturing process and measurements. All specifications are subject to the actual product.

3. Armor 28 Ultra is splash, water, and dust resistant and was tested under controlled laboratory conditions with a rating of IP68 under IEC standard 60529 (maximum depth of 2 meters up to 30 minutes). Charger and accessories are not water-resistant. Splash, water and dust resistance are not permanent and might decrease as a result of normal wear. Do not attempt to charge a wet Armor 28 Ultra. Liquid damage not covered under warranty.

4. Armor 28 Ultra has waterproof plugs for its charging port and audio jack, please tightly put the plugs into the holes before you put an Armor 28 Ultra into water.

5. The Custom Key and its ability to quickly access different functions, except SOS, work only when the phone screen is unlocked.

6. The actual available RAM and storage are less than the listed total capacity due to the occupied storage of the operating system and software pre-installed in the device.

7. The micro SD card is not included, and need to be purchased separately. It is recommended to use Class 10 memory cards, other types of memory cards are not guaranteed to be fully compatible.

8. 6.67 inches is the diagonal length of the main display when the four rounded corners are taken to be pointed corners, the actual viewable area is slightly smaller.

9. The resolution is measured as a standard rectangle with a rounded corners design, the effective pixels are slightly less.

10. The camera software functions are subject to the actual presence, some of functions and names may vary depending on the software version.

11. The actual photo and video resolution may vary depending on the shooting mode.

12. NFC and Google Pay is supported, and you are suggested to download Google Pay to use it; the available countries and regions are for your reference: https://pay.google.com/about.

13. The product, accessories, and package may vary in different markets. Pictures are for reference only. Please refer to the actual products.

14. Whether you can use VoLTE depends on the local carriers, please note that not all of your local carriers support this function.

15. The virtual(dynamic) memory can be activated in Settings at your will.

16. Datas are from Ulefone lab, the actual performance may vary.

17. The wireless charging stand is sold separately.

18. The Armor case mentioned above, combined with a back clip and a carabiner in one set is sold separately.

19. Sports Armband is sold separately.

20. Armor Mount Pro is sold separately.

21. For more devices that are compatible with uSmart Expansion Connector, refer to the accessories list. Expansion devices require additional purchases.

22. A rated capacity of 5300mAh at 7.74V is equivalent to 10600mAh capacity. Power consumption data above are from Ulefone lab, which will be varied by actual usage.

23. Armor 28 Ultra, pre-installed with Android 14, will update to Android 15 in Q1 2025 via OTA. Timing to be announced.

24. Armor 28 Ultra supports DP1.4 protocol, and a display screen that supports the DP protocol is required for screen casting.

25. AI Removal and Background are on-device AI, enhanced by cloud AI online. Other features use cloud AI without data storage.

26. The AI Digital Human and AI Photography features offer a complimentary limit of 20 productions daily. Any production beyond this limit will incur additional charges.

27. The sub screen's watch face is for demonstration only, please refer to its actual.

UI/Features Interface Display Default features include clock, compass, music, camera, and calendar. Users can add recording, noise measurement, barometer, power saving mode, and scenario mode through the settings menu. Interface switching is supported by swiping left or right.
Watch Face Customization of watch face wallpapers is available through the settings menu or by double-tapping on the sub-screen watch face, then swiping left/right and long-pressing to select a watch face wallpaper. Different watch face designs display various information such as digital clock, date, battery level, step count, and air pressure.
Music Playback Supports selection of different music apps. Displays music playback status and song title. Users can control play/pause, and navigate to the previous/next track. The media app's poster can be synchronized and displayed on the sub-screen.
Photo Capture Provides quick access to photo capture, switching between front and rear cameras. Users can return to the camera, view photos, and check full-size images in the gallery app.
Notifications By swiping up on the sub-screen, users can quickly view notifications and messages.
Status By swiping down on the sub-screen, users can quickly check the battery status.
Personal Signature Displays a personal signature upon screen-on, which can be customized in the sub-screen settings menu.

Notes:

1. The battery is non-removable, removing it may cause damage to the device.

2. Product size and weight may vary by configuration, manufacturing process and measurements. All specifications are subject to the actual product.

3. Armor 28 Ultra is splash, water, and dust resistant and was tested under controlled laboratory conditions with a rating of IP68 under IEC standard 60529 (maximum depth of 2 meters up to 30 minutes). Charger and accessories are not water-resistant. Splash, water and dust resistance are not permanent and might decrease as a result of normal wear. Do not attempt to charge a wet Armor 28 Ultra. Liquid damage not covered under warranty.

4. Armor 28 Ultra has waterproof plugs for its charging port and audio jack, please tightly put the plugs into the holes before you put an Armor 28 Ultra into water.

5. The Custom Key and its ability to quickly access different functions, except SOS, work only when the phone screen is unlocked.

6. The actual available RAM and storage are less than the listed total capacity due to the occupied storage of the operating system and software pre-installed in the device.

7. The micro SD card is not included, and need to be purchased separately. It is recommended to use Class 10 memory cards, other types of memory cards are not guaranteed to be fully compatible.

8. 6.67 inches is the diagonal length of the main display when the four rounded corners are taken to be pointed corners, the actual viewable area is slightly smaller.

9. The resolution is measured as a standard rectangle with a rounded corners design, the effective pixels are slightly less.

10. The camera software functions are subject to the actual presence, some of functions and names may vary depending on the software version.

11. The actual photo and video resolution may vary depending on the shooting mode.

12. NFC and Google Pay is supported, and you are suggested to download Google Pay to use it; the available countries and regions are for your reference: https://pay.google.com/about.

13. The product, accessories, and package may vary in different markets. Pictures are for reference only. Please refer to the actual products.

14. Whether you can use VoLTE depends on the local carriers, please note that not all of your local carriers support this function.

15. The virtual(dynamic) memory can be activated in Settings at your will.

16. Datas are from Ulefone lab, the actual performance may vary.

17. The wireless charging stand is sold separately.

18. The Armor case mentioned above, combined with a back clip and a carabiner in one set is sold separately.

19. Sports Armband is sold separately.

20. Armor Mount Pro is sold separately.

21. For more devices that are compatible with uSmart Expansion Connector, refer to the accessories list. Expansion devices require additional purchases.

22. A rated capacity of 5300mAh at 7.74V is equivalent to 10600mAh capacity. Power consumption data above are from Ulefone lab, which will be varied by actual usage.

23. Armor 28 Ultra, pre-installed with Android 14, will update to Android 15 in Q1 2025 via OTA. Timing to be announced.

24. Armor 28 Ultra supports DP1.4 protocol, and a display screen that supports the DP protocol is required for screen casting.

25. AI Removal and Background are on-device AI, enhanced by cloud AI online. Other features use cloud AI without data storage.

26. The AI Digital Human and AI Photography features offer a complimentary limit of 20 productions daily. Any production beyond this limit will incur additional charges.

27. The sub screen's watch face is for demonstration only, please refer to its actual.

Main Display

UI/Features Interface Display Default features include clock, compass, music, camera, and calendar. Users can add recording, noise measurement, barometer, power saving mode, and scenario mode through the settings menu. Interface switching is supported by swiping left or right.
Watch Face Customization of watch face wallpapers is available through the settings menu or by double-tapping on the sub-screen watch face, then swiping left/right and long-pressing to select a watch face wallpaper. Different watch face designs display various information such as digital clock, date, battery level, step count, and air pressure.
Music Playback Supports selection of different music apps. Displays music playback status and song title. Users can control play/pause, and navigate to the previous/next track. The media app's poster can be synchronized and displayed on the sub-screen.
Photo Capture Provides quick access to photo capture, switching between front and rear cameras. Users can return to the camera, view photos, and check full-size images in the gallery app.
Notifications By swiping up on the sub-screen, users can quickly view notifications and messages.
Status By swiping down on the sub-screen, users can quickly check the battery status.
Personal Signature Displays a personal signature upon screen-on, which can be customized in the sub-screen settings menu.

FAQ

If you have any questions or concerns, please do not hesitate to contact us.

Do you ship overseas?

Yes, we ship all over the world. Shipping costs will apply, and will be added at checkout. We run discounts and promotions all year, so stay tuned for exclusive deals.

How long will it take to get my orders?

It depends on where you are. Orders processed here will take 5-7 business days to arrive. Overseas deliveries can take anywhere from 7-16 days. Delivery details will be provided in your confirmation email.

Any question?

You can contact us through our contact page! We will be happy to assist you.
